claims.claim: Amphilochius of Iconium was a fourth‑century bishop of Iconium in Lycaonia, born around 340 CE and died after 394 CE.
He came from a distinguished Cappadocian family, was a first cousin of Gregory of Nazianzus and a close associate of Basil of Caesarea.
The Oratio in resurrectionem domini is a homily (sermon) composed for the celebration of the Lord’s Resurrection (Easter).
The homily emphasizes theological themes of resurrection, redemption, and the transformation of believers from death to life, reflecting the doctrinal concerns of the post‑Nicene church.
